product_summary: Established 1964, Mumbai (tel. +91-22-2529-9990). Self-described as 'manufacturing and marketing' with an in-house QA/R&D laboratory and a 'Toll Blending' facility. Confirmed product families from the company's own website (easternpetroleum.in, homepage, retrieved): (1) Automotive oils — engine oil, 4T/2T, gear/transmission oil, brake fluid, tractor, genset, coolant, shock-absorber oil, pumpset oil, gas engine oil; (2) Industrial oils — turbine, hydraulic (antiwear/HLP/HVI/zinc-free), way oil, industrial gear, compressor, refrigeration, sugar-mill, open-gear, steel-mill, Morgan bearing, mist oils; (3) Industry speciality — heat transfer fluid, rubber process oil, mould oil, fire-resistant hydraulic fluid, ink oil, rubber extender oil, glass mould oil, concrete mould/form/shuttering oil, aluminium & SS rolling oils; (4) Metal-working fluids — soluble/semi-synthetic/neat cutting oils, grinding fluids, drawing oil, honing, gun-drilling, broaching, tapping, EDM oil, quenching oil, polymer quenchant, rust preventives; (5) Textile oils — spindle, scourable, coning, wool combing, knitting, loom; (6) Marine oils; (7) Base oils — solvent neutral, bright stock, naphthenic, Group II, alkalate; (8) Used/recycled oils — used engine oil, used vacuum oil, used thermic fluid, used lube oil; (9) Petroleum sulphonates — sodium, calcium, barium, magnesium; (10) Solvents — paraffinic low-aromatic, de-aromatised, de-odourised; (11) Emulsifiers, fuel & lube additives, filter-aid powder, 'Power Acids'/'Spent Acid'; (12) Specialty oils & waxes — light & heavy liquid paraffin, white mineral oil, transformer oil, petroleum jelly, white/yellow soft paraffin IP, paraffin wax, micro-crystalline wax, bees wax, emulsifying wax; (13) Greases — silicone, wheel-bearing, multi-purpose, high-temperature, EP, moly, lithox, chassis, cup, high-vacuum; (14) 'Eastto' mosquito larvicidal oil (MLO).
role_hint: manufacturer (with toll-blending services and a very wide own-brand 'Eastto' range). No trader/import-resale signals found on the site; no evidence of being a pure trader. Role cannot be fully confirmed without registry data (out of scope for this task).
comment: HS mapping vs declared codes: (a) 271019 — CORRECT and dominant. The overwhelming majority of the catalogue (lubricating oils, base oils, hydraulic/turbine/gear/compressor/transformer/heat-transfer oils, metal-working oils, white mineral oil, liquid paraffin, solvents, used oils) falls in 2710.19. Exact match. (b) 271210 — PARTIAL/IMPRECISE. 2712.10 is petroleum jelly specifically; the site does list petroleum jelly and white/yellow soft paraffin IP, so the code is defensible, but the declaration omits the company's substantial wax lines which belong in 2712.20 (paraffin wax) and 2712.90 (micro-crystalline wax, emulsifying wax). Recommend adding 2712.20 and 2712.90. (c) 350790 — WRONG. 3507.90 is enzymes / prepared enzymes. Nothing on the company's website indicates enzyme products. The declared code appears to be a mis-keying of the company's flagship 'Petroleum Sulphonates' (sodium/calcium/barium/magnesium petroleum sulphonate), which are anionic surface-active agents and belong in 3402.11/3402.19 (or 3824.99 depending on presentation), not 3507.90. This is a genuine HS misclassification to be corrected, not a reason to reject the company (per Rule 3). Missing from the declaration: 3403.11/3403.19 and 3403.99 (metal-working and lubricating preparations — a major, explicitly advertised product line), 3402.11/3402.19 (sulphonates/emulsifiers), 3824.99 (fuel & lube additives, filter aid), 2712.20/2712.90 (waxes), and 3808.94 (mosquito larvicidal oil). Industry label 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas / chemicals) is broadly accurate but imprecise: the company is a lubricant blender and specialty petroleum-chemicals manufacturer, not an upstream oil & gas or petrochemical-cracker operator. No crude oil, LPG, natural gas, bitumen or fuel (petrol/diesel/ATF) trading lines were found on the site, so 2710.11–2710.12 and 2713.20 should not be assumed. Evidence basis: only the homepage of easternpetroleum.in resolved; all sub-pages tried (sodium-petroleum-sulphonate, light-liquid-paraffin-oil-ip, about-us, toll-blending) returned HTTP 404, and the search backend was unavailable, so no independent corroboration was possible. Therefore every product line above is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — declared on the company's own website, not corroborated by any customs line or shipment record. No export or domestic supply evidence was assessed here (out of scope for this HS/product task). No revenue, CIN, PAN or shipment figures are stated because none were retrieved.
